description: RAGAS evaluation question set for the Egyptian Civil Code RAG system. 54 questions across 4 categories, stratified deliberately (see docs/ragas_mlflow_plan.md), not randomly sampled. Every ground_truth is drawn from article text this project directly verified earlier (extraction spot-checks, chunking checks, or live /ask tests) -- not invented. Ground truth is kept in English throughout regardless of question language, since that is the most reliably verified source text; this is a known simplification worth revisiting if RAGAS scoring shows a language-mismatch penalty for the Arabic questions.

categories.substantive: 26 (13 topics x AR/EN pair) -- real legal questions with verifiable article content, spanning general provisions, persons/capacity, contracts, sale, mandate, and servitudes.
categories.article_lookup: 12 -- the exact "What does Article N say?" query shape that exposed a real retrieval gap (see docs/decisions.md); spread across article numbers not limited to the one that surfaced the bug.
categories.repealed_status: 10 -- explicit ranges (54-80, 389-417), individual articles inside a repealed range (not just the range-summary text), and negative controls (147, 1149 -- NOT repealed, checks the system does not over-flag).
categories.out_of_corpus: 6 -- tests the prompt's explicit "do not guess" instruction; faithfulness should stay high even when the honest answer is "not enough information," not degrade into a plausible-sounding hallucination.

questions.question: What happens if unforeseen exceptional circumstances make contract performance excessively burdensome for the debtor?
questions.ground_truth: The judge may, according to the circumstances and after weighing both parties' interests, reduce the excessive obligation to a reasonable limit. Any agreement to the contrary is void.

questions.question: ماذا يحدث إذا جعلت ظروف استثنائية غير متوقعة تنفيذ العقد مرهقاً للمدين؟
questions.ground_truth: The judge may, according to the circumstances and after weighing both parties' interests, reduce the excessive obligation to a reasonable limit. Any agreement to the contrary is void.

questions.question: In the absence of an applicable legal provision, what does the judge decide according to?
questions.ground_truth: The judge decides according to custom, and in the absence of custom, according to the principles of Islamic (Moslem) law, and in the absence of such principles, according to natural justice and equity.

questions.question: إذا لم يوجد نص تشريعي ينطبق على مسألة معينة، فبماذا يحكم القاضي؟
questions.ground_truth: The judge decides according to custom, and in the absence of custom, according to the principles of Islamic (Moslem) law, and in the absence of such principles, according to natural justice and equity.

questions.question: How can a legal provision be repealed?
questions.ground_truth: A provision of law can only be repealed by a subsequent law that expressly provides for repeal, contains a provision inconsistent with the earlier law, or regulates anew a matter already regulated by the earlier law.

questions.question: كيف يمكن إلغاء نص تشريعي؟
questions.ground_truth: A provision of law can only be repealed by a subsequent law that expressly provides for repeal, contains a provision inconsistent with the earlier law, or regulates anew a matter already regulated by the earlier law.

questions.question: At what age does a person reach legal majority in Egypt?
questions.ground_truth: A person attaining majority in possession of their mental faculties, and not under legal disability, has full legal capacity. Majority is fixed at twenty-one complete Gregorian years.

questions.question: في أي سن يبلغ الشخص سن الرشد القانوني في مصر؟
questions.ground_truth: A person attaining majority in possession of their mental faculties, and not under legal disability, has full legal capacity. Majority is fixed at twenty-one complete Gregorian years.

questions.question: What is the basic legal definition of a contract of sale?
questions.ground_truth: Sale is a contract whereby the vendor binds himself to transfer to the purchaser the ownership of a thing, or another proprietary right, in consideration of a price in money.

questions.question: ما هو التعريف القانوني الأساسي لعقد البيع؟
questions.ground_truth: Sale is a contract whereby the vendor binds himself to transfer to the purchaser the ownership of a thing, or another proprietary right, in consideration of a price in money.

questions.question: How long after delivery can a purchaser claim on a warranty for defects in a thing sold?
questions.ground_truth: An action on a warranty is prescribed one year from the time of delivery, even if the defect is discovered after that period, unless the vendor agreed to a longer warranty period or fraudulently concealed the defect.

questions.question: كم من الوقت بعد التسليم يمكن للمشتري المطالبة بالضمان عن عيوب المبيع؟
questions.ground_truth: An action on a warranty is prescribed one year from the time of delivery, even if the defect is discovered after that period, unless the vendor agreed to a longer warranty period or fraudulently concealed the defect.

questions.question: Where must a purchaser pay the price, absent a contrary agreement?
questions.ground_truth: Subject to a clause or custom to the contrary, the price is payable at the place where delivery of the thing sold is made.

questions.question: أين يجب على المشتري دفع الثمن في حال عدم وجود اتفاق مخالف؟
questions.ground_truth: Subject to a clause or custom to the contrary, the price is payable at the place where delivery of the thing sold is made.

questions.question: How does a mandate (agency contract) come to an end?
questions.ground_truth: A mandate comes to an end by the completion of the work for which it was given, or by the expiration of its term.

questions.question: كيف تنتهي الوكالة؟
questions.ground_truth: A mandate comes to an end by the completion of the work for which it was given, or by the expiration of its term.

questions.question: After how many years does the right to a servitude become extinguished through non-use?
questions.ground_truth: The rights to a servitude are extinguished by non-user for a period of fifteen years; if the servitude benefits a wakf property, this period is thirty-three years.

questions.question: بعد كم سنة ينقضي حق الارتفاق بسبب عدم استعماله؟
questions.ground_truth: The rights to a servitude are extinguished by non-user for a period of fifteen years; if the servitude benefits a wakf property, this period is thirty-three years.

questions.question: Who bears the cost of works necessary to use and preserve a servitude, absent an agreement to the contrary?
questions.ground_truth: In the absence of an agreement to the contrary, the cost of the necessary works for the use and preservation of the servitude must be borne by the owner of the dominant tenement.

questions.question: من يتحمل تكلفة الأعمال اللازمة لاستعمال حق الارتفاق والمحافظة عليه في حال عدم وجود اتفاق؟
questions.ground_truth: In the absence of an agreement to the contrary, the cost of the necessary works for the use and preservation of the servitude must be borne by the owner of the dominant tenement.

questions.question: What defines an alternative obligation?
questions.ground_truth: An obligation is alternative when its object includes several prestations and the debtor is entirely freed by performing just one of them; absent a special provision or agreement, the choice belongs to the debtor.

questions.question: ما هو تعريف الالتزام التخييري؟
questions.ground_truth: An obligation is alternative when its object includes several prestations and the debtor is entirely freed by performing just one of them; absent a special provision or agreement, the choice belongs to the debtor.

questions.question: Can a person renounce their personal liberty?
questions.ground_truth: No person can renounce their personal liberty.

questions.question: هل يجوز لأي شخص أن يتنازل عن حريته الشخصية؟
questions.ground_truth: No person can renounce their personal liberty.

questions.question: When is a person considered devoid of discretion and incapable of exercising civil rights?
questions.ground_truth: A person devoid of discretion due to youth, feeble-mindedness, or insanity is incapable of exercising civil rights; anyone who has not attained the age of seven is considered devoid of discretion.

questions.question: متى يعتبر الشخص فاقداً للتمييز وغير أهل لمباشرة حقوقه المدنية؟
questions.ground_truth: A person devoid of discretion due to youth, feeble-mindedness, or insanity is incapable of exercising civil rights; anyone who has not attained the age of seven is considered devoid of discretion.

questions.question: What does Article 43 say?
questions.ground_truth: It concerns the domicile of a missing or absent person, and the special domicile of a minor who has attained eighteen years for acts they are legally capable of performing.

questions.question: ما هو نص المادة 52؟
questions.ground_truth: It enumerates juristic persons, including the state, provinces, towns and villages, and other public entities the law grants legal personality.

questions.question: What does Article 274 say?
questions.ground_truth: An obligation with a suspensive term becomes due on the date the term expires; before that, the creditor may take measures to protect his rights if he fears the debtor may become insolvent.

questions.question: ما محتوى المادة 388؟
questions.ground_truth: A debtor cannot renounce the benefit of prescription before acquiring the right to invoke it, nor agree to a different prescription term than the one fixed by law.

questions.question: What is Article 1018 about?
questions.ground_truth: It concerns restrictions on building rights (such as height or area limits) that constitute servitudes in favor of neighboring properties, and remedies for breach.

questions.question: ما نص المادة 1024؟
questions.ground_truth: If the dominant tenement is divided, the servitude continues to benefit each part, provided the burden on the servient property is not increased.

questions.question: What does Article 1149 say?
questions.ground_truth: Co-owners who partitioned an immovable property have a privilege over it securing what is owed to them from the partition.

questions.question: أخبرني بمحتوى المادة 456
questions.ground_truth: Subject to a clause or custom to the contrary, the price is payable at the place where delivery of the thing sold is made.

questions.question: What is Article 673 about?
questions.ground_truth: It concerns obligations of customers of public utilities relating to the distribution of water, gas and similar services.

questions.question: ما هي المادة 1090؟
questions.ground_truth: The President of the Court records his order for a judgment charge establishing the value, at the foot of the relevant document.

questions.question: What does Article 1 say?
questions.ground_truth: Provisions of laws govern all matters to which they apply in letter or spirit; absent an applicable provision, the judge decides by custom, then Islamic law principles, then natural justice and equity.

questions.question: ما نص المادة 44؟
questions.ground_truth: A person attaining majority in possession of their mental faculties, and not under legal disability, has full legal capacity. Majority is fixed at twenty-one complete Gregorian years.

questions.question: Is the law about associations still in force?
questions.ground_truth: No. Articles 54 to 80 on associations were repealed by Presidential Decree Law No. 348 of 1956.

questions.question: هل ما زالت أحكام الجمعيات سارية؟
questions.ground_truth: No. Articles 54 to 80 on associations were repealed by Presidential Decree Law No. 348 of 1956.

questions.question: Is Article 65 currently valid law?
questions.ground_truth: No. Article 65 falls within Articles 54-80, which were repealed by Presidential Decree Law No. 348 of 1956.

questions.question: هل المادة 400 لا تزال نافذة؟
questions.ground_truth: No. Article 400 falls within Articles 389-417, which were repealed.

questions.question: What happened to the articles on proof of obligations (389-417)?
questions.ground_truth: Articles 389 to 417, covering proof of obligations, were repealed.

questions.question: هل تم إلغاء نصوص إثبات الالتزام؟
questions.ground_truth: Articles 389 to 417, covering proof of obligations, were repealed.

questions.question: Is Article 147 still in force?
questions.ground_truth: Yes, Article 147 (on unforeseen circumstances excessively burdening contract performance) is not repealed and remains in force.

questions.question: هل المادة 1149 لا تزال سارية؟
questions.ground_truth: Yes, Article 1149 is not repealed and remains in force.

questions.question: Is Article 390 currently applicable?
questions.ground_truth: No. Article 390 falls within Articles 389-417, which were repealed.

questions.question: هل يمكن الاستناد إلى نصوص المواد من 54 إلى 80 اليوم؟
questions.ground_truth: No. Articles 54 to 80 on associations were repealed by Presidential Decree Law No. 348 of 1956.

questions.question: What does Egyptian criminal law say about theft?
questions.ground_truth: Not covered -- this is the Civil Code, not the Penal Code. The system should decline to answer rather than guess.

questions.question: ما هو حكم القانون الجنائي المصري في جريمة السرقة؟
questions.ground_truth: Not covered -- this is the Civil Code, not the Penal Code. The system should decline to answer rather than guess.

questions.question: What is the minimum wage in Egypt according to this code?
questions.ground_truth: Not covered -- the Civil Code does not set labor minimum-wage rules. The system should decline to answer rather than guess.

questions.ground_truth: Article 5000 does not exist in this corpus (the code runs from Article 1 to 1149). The system should say so rather than fabricate content.

questions.ground_truth: Unrelated to the Civil Code corpus entirely. The system should decline to answer from this knowledge base rather than answer from general knowledge as if it were sourced.
